question: On a non-cube object, does choosing inspection direction and duration improve target binding and autonomous task completion over one prescribed sweep?
scope: New independent 40-pair Q3 inspection-policy study; not Q3(b), not pooled with the old cube Q3(c), not an extension of Q1 or Q2.

object_selection.rule: Choose an existing object with stable frozen low-level control and complete records, before any new active-versus-fixed outcomes are seen.
object_selection.reason: Pig has the fewest drops in the equal-length latent-controller holdouts among the four objects, and two Astra drops per Q1 mapping condition. Selection is based on motor stability, not expected adaptive-minus-fixed advantage.
object_selection.note: Continuous holdout success_events are not episode success rates. The high prior complete-system success also permits ceiling effects; it does not guarantee a detectable inspection-policy gain.

parent_code_audit.implication: Current workspace is not byte-identical to the old Q1 release. Do not weaken the existing guard. Create an isolated snapshot and explicitly audit shared infrastructure changes and the inspection-only intervention before freezing a new release.

common_configuration.semantic_model: gpt-6-astra; effective serving configuration must be verified and archived before formal launch
common_configuration.prompt_and_tools: Same object-specific semantic.py, same exact prompts/tool schema/decoding settings in both arms
common_configuration.camera: Existing frozen 512x512 native RGB; verify actual transport image preprocessing/crops
common_configuration.pose_source: Existing simulator-derived pose through the released noise/bias/failure/jitter/delay model; no new RGB pose estimator
common_configuration.maintenance: learned, same frozen maintenance actor in both arms
common_configuration.stopping: Same frozen calibrated completion correction and existing 3 Hz eligibility/stop logic, including the existing pending-request semantics
common_configuration.success: Correct requested letter-to-physical-skill binding AND true full-canonical quaternion error <=0.16 rad at autonomous stop, without a preceding drop

intervention.adaptive: Execute model-proposed inspect_face.number and inspect_face.steps unchanged (existing tool range 10..90 steps)

fixed.advancement: Advance index only when an inspect_face action is actually applied
fixed.rationale: Same color order as cube Q3(c), identifying purple with magenta; 60 steps at 20 Hz preserves the cube fixed sweep duration of 90 steps at 30 Hz. Not claimed optimal.

intervention.history_warning: Executed action must be returned in both arms; realized trajectories/history content and inference costs are not identical.

trial_plan.case_generation: Freeze all 40 cases before formal launch, cycle goal_index=global_case_index%6. Pair each arm by trial_seed, exact physical state and first-input image hash.
trial_plan.order: Run adjacent paired trials with arm order alternating AB,BA by pair; invert the first order in seed 2. Complete the full registered set regardless of observed effect.
trial_plan.service_policy: Preserve each raw attempt and exclude the union of service-affected pair IDs in both arms for paired primary analysis; physical failures remain outcomes. Pause on infrastructure/physics errors for diagnosis.

seed_collision_audit.scope: Only the listed experiment code/configuration and existing four-object/cube-Q3 releases plus new RGB pose plan; not an exhaustive scan of every historical output.
seed_collision_audit.final_requirement: Check all active registered manifests and freeze the new seed assignment before any engineering/formal use.

engineering_check.procedure: Use the frozen pig runtime and motor controller, apply the predeclared six inspect_face motor IDs for 60 steps each. Save initial/action-boundary RGB, executed skill, noisy feedback, and independent true pose only in audit fields. Do not use a language model or score adaptive-vs-fixed success.
admission: All initial states and complete traces retained, including failures; no capacity overflow/nonfinite state or resource collision.

A fixed sequence must produce distinct object orientations and visible patch regions; pixel changes alone are insufficient. Verify at least three distinct orientation/view states per completed sequence and inspect the synchronized RGB sequence.
Confirm all six commands use the intended physical skill IDs and canonical orientation definitions.
If the predeclared sweep fails the engineering check, stop and revise before freezing; keep failed diagnostics and do not use any formal state or success difference for tuning.

formal_admission: Independent visibility package/audit remains separate from this study.
New immutable source/artifact/prompt/tool/model-serving contract frozen; only inspection motor choice differs across arms.
Engineering view-change check passes; resource check ensures no interference with other tasks.

Separate paired live initialization checks verify same physical state, first model-input image, transport path, latency accounting, history semantics, and correct executed-action feedback; do not reuse these diagnostics as formal trials.
Archive actual endpoint/model identifier, available serving metadata, prompts, budgets and timestamps, without credentials.
Finalize the fixed budget and primary endpoint before obtaining formal outcomes.

analysis.primary: Paired autonomous success; two-sided exact McNemar with counts of discordant pairs and a paired effect interval
analysis.independence_unit: 40 paired trials, not model requests or frames
analysis.censoring: Keep never-bound and early-failure trials explicit; conditional time-to-binding alone is insufficient.
analysis.scope: One additional object and one prescribed sweep; no universal superiority claim or post-hoc sample expansion.
